children: Lister Thomas Arthur, an Officer serving as Chief Executive Officer, sold 30,000 Class A common shares at $44.2613 per share on August 26, 2026 for a total reported sale amount of $1,327,839, and following the transaction he directly owns 563,551 Class A common shares, which includes 15,211 vested-but-not-yet-issued shares and multiple categories of unvested awarded shares as described in the filing.

Psaropoulos Anastasios, an Officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, reported two sales on August 26, 2026 and August 27, 2026 disposing of a total of 50,000 Class A common shares at a weighted average price of approximately $45.0246 per share for a total reported sale amount of $2,251,239, and following the transactions he directly beneficially owned 450,160 Class A common shares.
